evals.prompt: Start the dev server so I can look at the blog page.
evals.expectedBehavior: Stand up astro dev on canonical port 4321, kill any stale server first, confirm the route responds, and hand back the localhost:4321 observation URL.

evals.prompt: My change to the design package isn't showing up on the page even after I saved it.
evals.expectedBehavior: Treat it as a cache problem first: note the file:-symlinked design-package caching caveat, clear .astro/ and node_modules/.vite, restart the dev server, then hard-refresh before suspecting the change.

evals.prompt: The page looks stale and there might be an old server still running on 4321.
evals.expectedBehavior: Kill the stale server holding port 4321, restart astro dev fresh, and hard-refresh the page before any measurement.

evals.prompt: Measure scrollWidth vs clientWidth on the code block and tell me if it overflows.
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger web-environment — that is a reproduce measurement (web-reproduce), not standing up or refreshing the environment.

evals.prompt: Which file should I look in for the code-block overflow bug?
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger web-environment — that is a source-location question (web-source-map), not an environment/server task.
